name: fig08_heat_capacity_stability
caption: Heat capacities in their stated ensembles. Schwarzschild: C = -2 S_BH < 0 (local thermodynamic instability). RN at fixed charge: positive for r_+ < sqrt(3)|Q| (near-extremal), diverging and negative beyond. Schwarzschild-AdS at fixed L: negative for r_+ < L/sqrt(3) (small BH), positive for large BH. Local thermodynamic stability is distinct from global preference (Fig 09) and from dynamical stability, which is not analysed here.
